text:
maya.sales: Hey @eli.se @olga.security — GuardianTech (POC starting Mon) asked for a set of compliance artifacts to attach to their vendor review. They mentioned SOC2 excerpts, ISO scope, and some kind of pen-test attestation. What can we reasonably share for a POC?
eli.se: We can share a SOC2 Type II cover summary (not the full working papers). For ISO 27001 we can give the scope statement and certificate excerpt. For pen testing we provide a signed attestation/letter confirming a recent engagement and responsible-disclosure policy, but not raw vuln scans or third-party reports.
olga.security: Correct — we do a pen-test attestation (signed) and a short summary of findings if the customer has a legit, supervised test. We won't hand over raw reports. Need to know whether they want screenshots of KMS/HSM or just controls summary. Also need legal entity name for signature.
sam.cs: Quick note on logistics — we can provide a secure S3 presigned upload for evidence and supervise any external tests. For a supervised scan we require: source IP list, test window, scope (staging/dedicated only), and an NDA addendum.
maya.sales: GuardianTech wants to know whether Dedicated pricing includes this support or if it’s extra. They’re also asking if they can run an authenticated scan against the POC endpoint.
eli.se: Pricing: normal evidence and standard attestation letter are included for enterprise POCs. Extended audit assistance, custom on-prem packaging, or time-consuming redlines are billable (we recommend quoting as a small SOW add-on). Authenticated scans are allowed only on dedicated/staging endpoints with pre-approval — we handle supervision as a paid service if they want our team to be present.
maya.sales: OK — can someone put together the minimal artifact checklist I should send now? They want a short list to drop into their procurement packet.
olga.security: Here’s a concise list you can send (copy/paste):
```
- SOC 2 Type II: cover letter / attestation excerpt (no raw audit docs)
- ISO 27001: certificate excerpt + scope statement
- Pen-test attestation letter (signed summary; no raw reports)
- Redacted network diagram (high-level, no sensitive IPs)
- Data residency & encryption statement (KMS controls summary)
- Pre-scan checklist and supervised-scan process doc
- Contact for compliance SOW / dedicated-support quote
```
Lead times: 3-5 business days for the attestation/one-pager, 5-10 days if we need legal sign-off or extra redaction.
eli.se: I'll add a short pricing blurb you can paste: "Standard POC evidence pack included for enterprise trials. Extended audit assistance (legal sign-off, bespoke redaction, supervised testing) billed via SOW; indicative pricing starts at $5k for a short engagement."
maya.sales: GuardianTech legal name looks like "GuardianTech, Inc." — confirmed. They asked for SFTP rather than email for the artifacts. Can you set up the presigned S3 link, @sam.cs?
sam.cs: Will do. I’ll provision a time-limited S3 share and post the presigned URL in the customer thread. I’ll also attach the pre-scan checklist. Need to know their test window preference and IP ranges.
maya.sales: I’ll ask them for preferred test windows and the IP list. Draft reply to customer below — please tweak: "Thanks — we can provide SOC2 cover excerpt, ISO scope, and a signed pen-test attestation. We’ll provision a secure upload (S3) and can supervise any scans against a dedicated staging endpoint; please share test window and source IPs. Standard evidence is included in the POC; supervised scans / extended audit support may be quoted separately."
olga.security: Looks good. Add: "We do not share raw vuln reports; only attestation summaries."
maya.sales: Updated and sending now.
deploy-bot: File created: /evidence/provisioning/guardiantech-presigned-req.txt (private).
sam.cs: Uploaded presigned S3 URL to the customer ticket and added the pre-scan checklist.
eli.se: Thanks everyone — I'll include the pricing note in the quote doc. maya.sales, mark me if legal asks for wording.
maya.sales: Will do. cc @olga.security for sign-off on the attestation language. :+1:
